rows.Kwic: 超群拔萃的，直下荷擔；迷頭認影的，當面錯過。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Dongshan Meixi Du (東山梅溪度禪師語錄): in his hall address, Meixi Fudu contrasts directly shouldering it with missing it face-to-face.

rows.Kwic: 昔覯芝眉，未談西意，竟不識足下個中脫略、筆底琳琅，誠所謂當面錯過也。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Dongshan Meixi Du (東山梅溪度禪師語錄): in his reply to layman Yuye Huang, Meixi Fudu calls his earlier failure to recognize the layman's freedom missing it face-to-face.
